title: Projective resolution of excellent integral surfaces
statement: Let $Y$ be an integral Noetherian excellent scheme of dimension $2$, admitting an ample invertible sheaf [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. There is a projective birational morphism $r:V\to Y$, where $V$ is integral and regular [def-weil-regular-scheme], which is an isomorphism over the regular locus of $Y$. Here projective means factoring as a closed immersion into some $\mathbf P^m_Y$ followed by its projection, and birational means inducing an isomorphism of function fields [def-sc-function-field].
